title: Household Add-On Membership: when the early-termination fee applies and when it is waived
content:
## Product and scope
This document states the Household Add-On Membership basis for the early-termination fee charged when a household add-on is removed before its tier's minimum commitment term has elapsed, and the relocation basis on which that fee is waived.

## Rule
An add-on that is removed before its tier's minimum commitment term has elapsed, counted from the date the add-on was activated, is charged that tier's flat early-termination fee. The fee is waived entirely where the tier makes the relocation waiver available and the removal is supported by a documented relocation that is at least that tier's qualifying distance away.

## Points of judgement
- The clock the minimum commitment term counts from is the add-on's own activation, not the date the primary member's underlying club membership began and not the date the removal request is made.
- The waiver has two parts that must both hold: the tier itself must make the relocation waiver available, and the documented relocation itself must meet or exceed that tier's qualifying distance. A relocation shorter than the tier's qualifying distance does not satisfy the "beyond" part of the waiver, even where the tier makes the waiver available in principle.
- Where the waiver does not apply, the fee charged is the flat amount set for that tier; it is not prorated by how much of the minimum term remains.

The minimum commitment term, the flat fee amount, whether the relocation waiver is available, and the qualifying relocation distance in force for each add-on tier are recorded in that tier's own parameter basis.
